summary: The Williams Companies, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing that it filed a prospectus supplement to its existing Form S-3 shelf registration statement (File No. 333-277232) covering the resale of up to 26,874,496 shares of common stock by selling securityholders. The registrant is the issuer and not a party to any special-situation transaction. The filing includes a legal opinion on share validity from Davis Polk & Wardwell LLP. This is a routine shelf takedown for secondary resale, not an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special situation. No extraordinary corporate event is indicated. The appropriate classification is 'None'.
